# Third-party notices

PL_MPEG retains MIT attribution in its source and PL_MPEG.md. citro2d/citro3d, LZ4, JPEG and zlib notices are included here. libmpg123 1.31.3 source is included as its upstream source archive with COPYING and AUTHORS; it retains its LGPL terms. devkitPro SDK/tools are not copied into this repository. Developers can use their own local application objects, SMDH and RomFS with release/relink.py to relink a replacement mpg123 library. The SDK library hashes used for this build are recorded in sdk-libraries.json.

Upstream SDK sources: https://github.com/devkitPro/libctru , https://github.com/devkitPro/citro2d , https://github.com/devkitPro/citro3d . Compiler runtime: GCC Runtime Library Exception applies to the compiler runtime; see https://www.gnu.org/licenses/gcc-exception-3.1.html . Original Lume content is outside the project GPL license.

The runtime fallback font is derived from Daniel Hepper's public-domain font8x8. The unmodified upstream header, attribution and immutable source checksums are in font8x8/. Original Lume glyph data is not compiled into player/lume.3dsx.
